description: Land Title Settlement Department - Suriyapaluwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510821
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 174 and 266) with detailed ownership information, property boundaries, and title classifications. The content focuses on land ownership rights, property registration, and title settlement - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
